Terrible experience. The painting service specifically isn't bad, but everything else is horrible. I left all my Harley parts, including nameplates, tips and accessories for painting, and after three weeks I had to call to see if they were ready. I went to pick them up thinking they would deliver the parts assembled as they were received. However, I received the parts and a bag with screws and tips; they didn't deliver them assembled. When I got home, I realized the two saddlebag lids were missing; they had forgotten to deliver them, and I had to go back to get them. After a few days, I went to assemble the hardware for the parts and realized many things were missing, but they haven't responded, and I'm having to buy everything that's missing. So far, I've spent over $300 and haven't gotten everything they failed to deliver. The place is messy and disorganized. I'm disappointed and regretful.

On Oct. 27th i took my car to Michael (owner) of C & S upholstery. We agreed to do the front and back seats for $1200. I gave him $600 half down. We agreed on a 2 week time period. 7 days went by and I called to check on the progress. Michael said his tools and machine had been stolen by his drug addict employee which he did not pay in cash that day. Then Michael tells me he would wave the final $600 for the inconvenience to me case it's gonna take longer. So now we are 16 days in on the project and he sees he cannot make any kind of deadline. I said just do the front seats and not the back and we will call it even. Frustrations are starting to build here. This guy is hard to deal with cause he twist things and lies so it will suit him and NOT the customer. For instance, I go to pick up the car at 6pm yesterday (day 18 from drop of date) and the front seats are done but not the headrest! Who does that??? That IS part of the seat. And there are NO backseats in my car. Gone. Michael proceeds to show me the front seats like I would grandstand over them. I did not. Come to find out my backseat are at his house in Mesquite 45 minute away. He is arguing with me over the back seats and then dissappeears to the gas station next door. I go to the gas station next door and he is in the back playing video games hiding from me hoping I would go away. I told him I would call the police and report my stolen seats. Somehow he decided in the midst of his lies and stalling that after an hour and a half that I would follow him to his house to get the seats. I did just that. This nonsense and bad business practice should not go unnoticed. PEOPLE I WARN YOU TO NOT TAKE YOUR BUSINESS HERE. Michael lies, you cannot trust him. I gave 1 star because I cannot give 0.
This place IS NOT REPUTABLE.  Michael (owner) isn't timely, doesn't do what he says he's going to, he lies and there is NO CUSTOMER SERVICE  only what suits him in the end.
